<a id="active"></a>
## 🟢 Ezitholakalayo

Imikhawulo isekelwe ekuqapheleni komphakathi. Iminikelo yangasese ingabalwa uma isilungiselelo sivuliwe.

<a id="starstruck"></a>
### Starstruck

<img src="../assets/badges/starstruck-default.png" width="96" alt="Starstruck">

Dala indawo yokugcina enezinkanyezi **eziyi-16**; amazinga aphezulu ancike ezinkanyezini zayo.

**Amazinga:** 16 → 128 → 512 → 4096 (izinkanyezi zendawo yokugcina).

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S21](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=starstruck&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pull-shark"></a>
### Pull Shark

<img src="../assets/badges/pull-shark-default.png" width="96" alt="Pull Shark">

Yiba umbhali wama-**pull request amabili ahlanganisiwe**.

**Amazinga:** 2 → 16 → 128 → 1024 (ama-PR ombhali ahlanganisiwe).

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S22](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=pull-shark&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="pair-extraordinaire"></a>
### Pair Extraordinaire

<img src="../assets/badges/pair-extraordinaire-default.png" width="96" alt="Pair Extraordinaire">

Bhala ama-commit ngokuhlanganyela ku-**PR eyodwa ehlanganisiwe**, usebenzise `Co-authored-by` ngokufanele.

**Amazinga:** 1 → 10 → 24 → 48 (ama-PR abhalwe ngokuhlanganyela ahlanganisiwe).

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S23](https://github.com/Rongronggg9?achievement=pair-extraordinaire&tab=achievements) · [S18](https://docs.github.com/en/pull-requests/committing-changes-to-your-project/creating-and-editing-commits/creating-a-commit-with-multiple-authors) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="galaxy-brain"></a>
### Galaxy Brain

<img src="../assets/badges/galaxy-brain-default.png" width="96" alt="Galaxy Brain">

Thola **izimpendulo ezimbili ezamukelwe** ku-Discussions. Ku-`github.com/orgs/community` kukhutshaziwe kusukela ngo-2024-02-06.

**Amazinga:** 2 → 8 → 16 → 32 (izimpendulo ezamukelwe).

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S24](https://github.com/ljharb?achievement=galaxy-brain&tab=achievements) · [S06](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/106536) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="quickdraw"></a>
### Quickdraw

<img src="../assets/badges/quickdraw-default.png" width="96" alt="Quickdraw">

Vala i-issue noma i-PR **kungakapheli imizuzu emihlanu** uyivulile.

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S25](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=quickdraw&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="yolo"></a>

Hlanganisa i-PR yakho **ngaphandle kokubuyekezwa kwekhodi**; imithetho esemthethweni enemininingwane ayishicilelwe.

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S26](https://github.com/Schweinepriester?achievement=yolo&tab=achievements) · [S03](https://github.blog/news-insights/product-news/introducing-achievements-recognizing-the-many-stages-of-a-developers-coding-journey/) · [S15](https://github.com/Schweinepriester/github-profile-achievements)

<a id="retired"></a>
## 🕰️ Ezomlando

Le micimbi isiphelile. Imiklomelo emidala ingahlala; iminikelo emisha ayiyivuli.

<a id="arctic-code-vault-contributor"></a>
### Arctic Code Vault Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/arctic-code-vault-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Arctic Code Vault Contributor">

Nikela endaweni efanele ku-**Arctic Code Vault snapshot yango-2020-02-02**. Umcimbi uvaliwe.

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/JakubOleksy?achievement=arctic-code-vault-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S04](https://github.blog/open-source/maintainers/the-arctic-code-vault-starts-production-and-your-open-source-projects-are-being-archived/) · [S05](https://archiveprogram.github.com/)

<a id="mars-2020-contributor"></a>
### Mars 2020 Contributor

<img src="../assets/badges/mars-2020-contributor-default.png" width="96" alt="Mars 2020 Contributor">

Bhala i-commit enguqulweni ethile esetshenziswe yi-**NASA/JPL Ingenuity**. Umcimbi usuphelile.

[Isibonelo sangempela](https://github.com/torvalds?achievement=mars-2020-contributor&tab=achievements) · [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S02](https://github.blog/news-insights/company-news/open-source-goes-to-mars/)

<a id="heart-on-your-sleeve"></a>
### Heart On Your Sleeve

<img src="../assets/badges/heart-on-your-sleeve-default.png" width="96" alt="Heart On Your Sleeve">

<a id="highlights"></a>
## ✨ Izimpawu zephrofayela

Ama-Highlights ayizimpawu ezihlukile zezinhlelo nama-akhawunti; ukutholakala kuncike ohlelweni.

| Igama | Isimo | Umbandela | Imithombo |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Pro** | Ezitholakalayo | Sebenzisa i-GitHub Pro. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Developer Program Member** | Ezitholakalayo | Joyina i-Developer Program wakhe uhlelo nge-GitHub API. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Bug Bounty Hunter** | Ezitholakalayo | Bika ubuthakathaka bokuphepha obufanele be-GitHub nge-Bug Bounty. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) · [S20](https://bounty.github.com/) |
| **GitHub Campus Expert** | Ezitholakalayo | Joyina i-GitHub Campus Experts; hlola imithetho yezicelo yamanje. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **Security Advisory Credit** | Ezitholakalayo | Thola ukuqashelwa kumnikelo weseluleko sokuphepha esamukelwe ku-GitHub Advisory Database. | [S01](https://docs.github.com/en/account-and-profile/reference/profile-reference) |
| **GitHub Star** | Ezitholakalayo | Khethwa ku-GitHub Stars; izinkanyezi zendawo yokugcina kuphela azanele. | [S16](https://stars.github.com/) |
| **Discussion answered** | Ezomlando | Uphawu oludala lwezimpendulo ezamukelwe; umphakathi wabika ukushintshwa yi-Galaxy Brain ngo-2022. | [S14](https://github.com/orgs/community/discussions/31629) |
